title: SOC configuration
description: Every tunable, once (FR-DEP-03, IR-CFG). Each consumer's configuration file holds exactly the keys that list it in x-consumers, all of them required, and nothing else; a default is what a new file starts from, never applied at load (ADR-0019). Addresses, ports and secrets come from the environment, declared in x-environment. x-unit, x-consumers, x-safety, x-constraints and x-environment are annotations; a validator ignores them.

SOC_CONFIG_FILE.description: The service's configuration file, an absolute path. soc-web's is checked by soc-config before the console starts, and handed to the browser as it is (ADR-0023).

SOC_DB_HOST.description: Virtual Origen's Postgres, reached directly on its network (ADR-0017).

SOC_DB_PASSWORD_SOC_CLOUD.description: Password of login role soc_cloud, the one the migration runner sets.

SOC_DB_PASSWORD_SOC_OPERATIONS.description: Password of login role soc_operations, the one the migration runner sets.

SOC_SUPABASE_URL.description: Virtual Origen's Supabase gateway, for Realtime Broadcast (ADR-0007).

SOC_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: The service role key, the only sender on SOC topics; never leaves the backend (NFR-SEC-02).

SOC_FLIGHT_FILES_PORT.description: Port the flight file server listens on, on Sky Orchestrator's network (ADR-0008).

served_organizations.description: The organizations the service acts for; anything else is refused (NFR-SEC-03). Has no default: a default organization is someone else's.

stacks.description: The Sky Orchestrator stacks, one MQTT connection each (FR-LNK-01). Has no default: addresses belong to the deployment.

telemetry_stale_after_ms.description: A fleet with no sample for this long is drawn as stale (FR-TEL-02).

telemetry_lost_after_ms.description: A fleet with no sample for this long has no current position; in flight, it raises the telemetry lost alarm (FR-TEL-02, FR-SAF-06).

telemetry_batch_s.description: Interval between the history writes of one aircraft (FR-TEL-04, NFR-RES-06).

command_reply_timeout_s.description: A wire command with no reply after this is timed out (FR-LNK-06).

command_intent_ttl_s.description: An intent claimed later than this after it was requested expires instead of running (ADR-0006).

geofence_warning_band_m.description: Distance inside the geofence boundary at which the console warns (FR-SAF-01).

geofence_max_vertices.description: Most vertices a geofence may have, generated or drawn (FR-GEO-03).

min_satellites.description: Fewest satellites for the GNSS check; Sky Orchestrator's own default and range (PF-GNSS).

min_gps_quality.description: Lowest positioning quality on DJI's 0 to 5 scale for the GNSS check (PF-GNSS).

min_battery_start_pct.description: Lowest battery to start an operation; Sky Orchestrator's own default and range (PF-BATTERY).

takeoff_tolerance_m.description: Farthest the aircraft may be from the planned takeoff point (PF-TAKEOFF).

min_arming_left_s.description: Least arming time left on the phone to launch (PF-ARMED).

max_arc_spacing_m.description: Longest arc between consecutive points of the circle tool (FR-WAY-04).

flight_file_grace_s.description: How long a flight file is still served after its flight ends (NFR-SEC-06).

broadcast_max_rate_hz.description: Most telemetry broadcasts per aircraft per second, latest sample wins (ADR-0007, NFR-RES-07).

stack_status_poll_ms.description: How often each stack's status is read from its wayline API. A read with no answer within the interval is recorded as unknown, never as the last value read (FR-LNK-08). It is shorter than telemetry_stale_after_ms, the age past which soc-operations no longer trusts a status, so a status read on time is always current.

stack_envelope_poll_s.description: How often each stack's flight envelope, the limits every flight file is judged against, is read from its wayline API. A read with no answer within the interval is recorded as unknown (FR-LNK-09).

name.description: Short name, in logs and on the console.

organization.description: The organization this stack's aircraft fly for: its stack, devices, fleets, telemetry and commands are that organization's (IR-STK). One of served_organizations.

flight_files_url.description: Where the dock reaches SOC's flight file server on this stack's network: plain http, as Sky Orchestrator downloads (ADR-0008).

username.description: Sky Orchestrator's Cloud API client credential, cloud-client (ADR-0004).

client_id.description: Stable, so the broker keeps the persistent session (FR-LNK-01).

url.description: so-wayline's HTTP API: status, envelope, validations (DEP-01, DEP-03, DEP-04).

environment_name.description: The environment variable holding the secret, never the secret (NFR-SEC-04).
